step: 1: benchmark and v1.0.0 baseline (measurement only; no writer behavior changed)

target.lake: final-only, launched as v1.0.0 on Delta: the primary commits every 60-120 s at the head and flushes by size only (32 MiB) while backfilling (#659)
target.measured_binary: main c6197d8 (fireparq 1.0.0), plain Parquet through the #468 protected journal; the Delta commit path (#643) is not implemented yet
target.superseded: 1 s and 5 s non-final head cadence, and 300 s plain-Parquet commits (runs completed before the change are under superseded_live_cadence; Arbitrum windows-300s stays as an extra data point)

machine.cpu: Apple M1 Max, 10 cores (8 performance + 2 efficiency)
machine.filesystem: APFS on internal SSD, 98% full (45 GiB free); Rust sync_all issues F_FULLFSYNC
machine.binary: fireparq 1.0.0, release build of main c6197d8 (sha256 e13351620d16dfe0efc66add6990525b25eaff447ee7a7cd73310ad70b3d4a28)
machine.note: shared with other agents building and testing concurrently; 1-minute load averages before and after each scenario are in load_average_1m

fixtures.retained: private local files only (not committed: 7.7 MB and 3.7 MB); regenerate with bench_live_flush capture; provider cursors are never stored

harness.s3_model: loopback HTTPS S3, HTTP/1.1 keep-alive, in-memory objects, half the injected latency before a request is applied and half after; slow variant: every 200th request takes 1000 ms; no bandwidth model
